item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 19
item.description:
16 development commits

Livestock & Animal Behavior

  • Leading livestock now works reliably and shows a visible rope.
  • Livestock headbutt damage increased; bulls no longer attack in safe zones; leading bulls stop fighting others; grazing through walls fixed; stop‑leading prompt bug fixed.
  • Livestock avoidance speed doubled, making them steer away from obstacles faster.
  • Bulls no longer attempt headbutts on unreachable players.
  • Animals no longer get stuck circling obstacles when fleeing or charging.

UI & Store

  • Store no longer shows a 'content failed to load' error when your inventory is empty.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 18
item.description:
93 development commits

Livestock & Wildlife

  • Fixed pregnant cows getting stuck between follow and play states.
  • Animals now avoid obstacles more reliably.
  • Wild sheep now flee when a player attempts to shave them.
  • Added new bull and cow trophy models.
  • Overhauled sheep shearing: fleece persists after server restarts, shearing no longer counts as combat, knives wound instead of shearing, correct wool payout, timers recover after saves, wool goes to backpack, fur baking limited to fleece models, and shearing works with any harvesting item (including new material), fixing lost‑state bugs.
  • Renamed raw, cooked, and spoiled "Lamb" meat to "Mutton".
  • Wild cows no longer breed, age, or produce resources; pregnancies only possible when condition is at least 60%.

Inventory & Loot

  • Respawnable fridges now assign a new first looter after items respawn.
  • Loadout items retain their positions when creating or deploying loadouts.

Combat & Tools

  • Grenades now support mask interactions, influencing visibility and targeting.
  • Added dedicated subsystems for many player tools (megaphone, mobile phone, compass, detonator, master key, water pistols, keycards), removing unnecessary holdtypes and overrides.

UI & Dialogue

  • Boat vendor dialogue now correctly indicates the direction to the purchased boat.
  • Livestock interaction popup repositioned to the right side, matching plant popups and keeping the model visible.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Skateboard cow durability increased, reducing breakage during use.
  • Crab swarms now move together with varied speeds based on size, improving their behavior.
  • Water height calculations corrected, fixing NaN issues that could cause abnormal water levels.
